intro: In Brill, Apothecary Johaan turns his attention toward developing a potent new biological agent for the Forsaken. By studying ancient texts, he discovers that a historic, deadly plague survived through the venom of eastern Tirisfal's night web spiders, prompting an urgent retrieval effort.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you were out gathering, I uncovered some old text in one of my tomes that indicates that an ancient plague wiped out thousands of innocent victims. Later it was discovered that the deadly agent in the plague was preserved through the venom of Night Web Spiders.

Bring me some venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider to complete this experiment. I want to see if the contagious element from the venom will work with my new concoction. Rumor has it the spiders can be found in Eastern Tirisfal Glades.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have some venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider yet, friend? It's the final component I need in order to test my experiment.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, this venom will do perfectly, friend. Everything else has been added to my concoction and boiled down. Finally, I am ready to try this new deadly agent!
